deep_dive_23494.root_cause_explanation: In Wialon telemetry, sensor io_253 / sensor 4 is a status flag that remains set to 1 continuously across consecutive telemetry frames during an entire acceleration window (or device interval). Counting every frame gives 0 raw records, whereas state transition deduplication (rising edge 0 -> 1) proves there were only 0 genuine events.
